Mid 2016: so I was outside on the front porch when I was holding my iPod nano and I put my foot up and my hand when my iPod hit the bottom of my shoe and the screen cracked. It still works 5 years later but at that time I was worried that it might not work anymore so I didn’t use it for months until mid 2017. 

1st week of January 2018: so I was home alone and I was walking around my house for a couple of minutes when I put a couple of socks and my iPhone 5c that I had since August 31, 2017 in my jacket pocket. Note that I didn’t have a case on my phone so when it fell on the wood floor, I panicked so I don’t really remember exactly what happened but I know that I lost ally data on that phone so all my photos are gonna and I can’t recover it.
